title: Measure
description: TOGAF-sourced norm archetype — a measurement definition specifying WHAT to measure and HOW, extending the GSM Norm's assertion grammar with TOGAF-specific measurement vocabulary (unit, aggregation, collection frequency). This is a measurement definition, not a measurement instance/observation. Requires GSM unsealing of Norm to be functional. Extends Norm with TOGAF Architecture Governance vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Measure / KPI (Architecture Governance, Performance Management). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Governance).

measureType.description: Measurement classification. KPI = key performance indicator. METRIC = quantitative measurement. INDICATOR = qualitative signal. TARGET = goal threshold. TOGAF mapping: Measure type in Architecture Governance.

unit.description: Measurement unit (e.g., 'percent', 'milliseconds', 'count', 'currency'). TOGAF mapping: Measure unit of measurement.

aggregation.description: Aggregation method for measurement collection. TOGAF mapping: Measure aggregation strategy.

collectionFrequency.description: Measurement collection frequency as ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'PT5M' for 5 minutes, 'P1D' for daily). TOGAF mapping: Measure collection schedule.
